title: Tutor configuration
description: Tutor values read as data (AR-22): the CandidateEnumerator's depth and Move set, the RecoveryPlanner's search bound, adaptive assistance thresholds (FR-13), and stage mastery thresholds (FR-4, FR-20, AD-6, UX Flow 7).

adaptive.description: When adaptive assistance changes the help: Harmful Moves on a step before it explains, demonstrates or guides (strictly increasing), and clean steps in a row before it reduces help.

mastery.description: Thresholds required to master a Stage: successful completions of the Stage Objective and how many must use reduced assistance (FR-4, FR-20, AD-6, UX Flow 7).
